verified_facts.text: The resort is on Ithaafushi Island in the South Male Atoll.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ithaafushi Island, South Male Atoll

verified_facts.text: The beach, reef and overwater villas span three islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your choice of 117 reef, beach, and overwater villas spans three islands of luxury.

verified_facts.text: Each villa is set in a private enclave with a pool and ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa is set in a private enclave with a pool and ocean views.

verified_facts.text: Ithaafushi, the private island, features a three-bedroom beach villa, a two-bedroom overwater villa, a four-bedroom residence, five pools and a private entertainment clubhouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ithaafushi features a three-bedroom beach villa, a two-bedroom overwater villa, four-bedroom residence, five pools and a private entertainment clubhouse.

verified_facts.text: At Terra, guests dine in one of seven private bamboo nests suspended high above the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine in one of seven private bamboo nests suspended high above the island.

verified_facts.text: Terra's pairings are curated by the Maldives' first resident Krug Ambassador.
verified_facts.excerpt: premium pairings curated by the Maldives’ first resident Krug Ambassador

verified_facts.text: Li Long serves Peking duck roasted in the Maldives' first classic wood-fired oven.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor signature Peking duck roasted in the Maldives’ first classic wood-fired oven.

verified_facts.text: The Rock is a subterranean cellar of Jordanian limestone centered on a 200-year-old Jarrah wood table, hosting wine dinners for 12 guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Descend into a subterranean cellar crafted from Jordanian limestone. Centered around a 200-year-old Jarrah wood table,  The Rock  hosts intimate wine dinners for 12 guests

verified_facts.text: Amber is the resort's signature overwater Champagne bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: As our signature overwater Champagne bar,  Amber  offers an exclusive selection of rare vintages

verified_facts.text: Zuma serves contemporary Japanese dining with robata and sushi in an overwater setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: the menu showcases authentic yet modern culinary artistry with signature robata, fresh sushi, and innovative kitchen creations in a stunning overwater setting.

verified_facts.text: The spa has the Maldives' first Aqua Wellness Centre, with a custom hydrotherapy pool, ice fountain, steam room and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the Maldives’ first Aqua Wellness Centre, featuring a custom hydrotherapy pool, ice fountain, steam room, and sauna.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers the Maldives' first Wellness Concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complemented by the Maldives’ first Wellness Concierge service

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Kids and Family sessions designed for 7 to 15 year olds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Share a bonding moment with a pampering session designed for 7 – 15 year olds.

verified_facts.text: Guests get a complimentary 30-minute session with the on-site tennis pro.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a complimentary 30-minute session with our on-site tennis pro.

verified_facts.text: Guests can adopt a coral frame to support the resort's coral nursery and Ocean Conservation Program.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adopt a coral frame to help restore ocean beauty and support our vital conservation efforts.

verified_facts.text: Water sports include parasailing and the Seabob underwater scooter.
verified_facts.excerpt: when you parasail above the sea or take the Seabob, our underwater scooter.

verified_facts.text: Weddings can be held on the beach or in an overwater Wedding Pavilion.
verified_facts.excerpt: Begin your forever together on pristine white sands or inside our elegant overwater Wedding Pavilion.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the reef villas as having an outdoor pool large enough for laps.
verified_facts.excerpt: an outdoor space with a pool large enough for laps at dusk when fruit bats swoop overhead

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the spa's roster of visiting practitioners such as Chinese acupuncturists and tarot card readers.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa excels in its roster of visiting practitioners likeChinese acupuncturists and tarot card readers

verified_facts.text: The resort is on Condé Nast Traveler's Gold List 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gold List 2025

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours.
